Our Python loader reads the first column of every Ledgerline CSV as `\ufeffDate`
instead of `Date`. A hex viewer shows the bytes EF BB BF at the start of the
file. Is that on purpose

args.title: Issue 4403: change src/export/csv.ts
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The file src/export/csv.ts contains code that adds a byte order mark (BOM) by default to the start of CSV exports. This behavior causes the CSV files to start with EF BB BF bytes, which is the UTF-8 BOM, explaining the issue raised about the byte order mark in the exported CSVs. This file is responsible because it explicitly prepends the BOM string when writing CSV files.
